description: This file contains integration tests for durable grain functionality in Orleans, focusing on state persistence, complex types, multiple collections, modifications, and large state handling.

classes.name: DurableGrainTests
classes.description: A test class containing multiple integration tests for Orleans durable grains, verifying persistence, complex state, multiple collections, modifications, and large state handling.

methods.name: DurableGrain_State_Persistence_Test
methods.description: Tests basic state persistence and recovery after grain deactivation.

methods.name: DurableGrain_Update_State_Test
methods.description: Verifies that state updates are journaled and persisted correctly.

methods.name: DurableGrain_Complex_Types_Test
methods.description: Checks serialization and persistence of complex objects and collections.

methods.name: DurableGrain_Multiple_Collections_Test
methods.description: Tests coexistence and persistence of multiple durable collections in a single grain.

methods.name: DurableGrain_State_Modifications_Test
methods.description: Verifies journaled modifications and recovery of complex state changes.

methods.name: Grain_State_Should_Persist_Between_Activations
methods.description: Ensures grain state persists across deactivations and reactivations.

methods.name: Grain_Should_Handle_Multiple_Collections
methods.description: Verifies collection operations and persistence across multiple deactivation cycles.

methods.name: Grain_Should_Handle_Large_State
methods.description: Stress tests large state handling and journaling performance.
